choice:4:1:2.text: You seem very familiar with the goddess.

choice:4:1:2.female: You seem very familiar with the goddess.

say:40:1510947008:1.text: I've always kept my power hidden, to keep things fair. Except in that last battle.

say:40:1510947008:1.female: I've always kept my power hidden, to keep things fair. Except in that last battle.

say:41:1510947009:1.text: Only divine power can stand against divine power. I couldn't just stand by and watch mortals become the Hunting Goddess' prey.
say:41:1510947009:1.source_cn: 唯有神力可对抗神力。我不能坐视凡人成为狩猎神的猎物。

say:7:1510949007:1.female: Modra always said the goddess would bless the Wildborn—that our spears would strike true, our hunts would thrive.

say:8:1510949008:1.female: I believed that. I found pride in devoting myself to the divine.

say:11:1510949011:1.text: That's not the kind of deity we need.

choice_prompt:12:1510949011.female: That's not the kind of deity we need.

say:13:1510949012:1.text: You protected me. You taught me. You even stooped to care for me, wiping my face...

say:16:1510909009:1.source_cn: 哦，差点忘了，你是个想弑神的“信徒”。

say:17:1510909010:0.text: Well, come on then. Just try not to die before you're useful.
say:17:1510909010:0.source_cn: 可以，来吧。你至少能帮我们挡几刀。

say:19:1510909011:0.text: Nazrik, you—why are you doing this?!

say:20:1510909012:1.text: Gala... If you want to protect <style="stress"><player_name></style>, then think carefully about what a god truly is.
say:20:1510909012:1.male: Gala... If you want to protect <style="stress"><player_name></style>, then think carefully about what a god truly is.
say:20:1510909012:1.female: Gala... If you want to protect <style="stress"><player_name></style>, then think carefully about what a god truly is.

say:21:1510909013:1.text: And what it will take to stop such a violent one.
say:21:1510909013:1.source_cn: 以及，怎么做才能阻止那残暴的神。

say:22:1510909014:1.text: You won't get many more chances. She nearly killed you.
say:22:1510909014:1.source_cn: 你没有多少机会，因为她差点就杀死了你。

narration:25:150109152:0.text: Red mist fills the air as the Blood Moon rises. It's time to confront Azora.
narration:25:150109152:0.source_cn: 红雾弥漫，血月已至。是时候迎战狩猎神了！

cinematic_dialogue:3:1510913001:.text: This isn't where you belong, Perseus!
cinematic_dialogue:3:1510913001:.source_cn: 那里不是你该在的地方，珀尔修斯！

say:6:1510912001:1.text: I'm not negotiating! <style="highlight">Retreat.</style> That's an order!

say:7:1510912002:0.text: And what? Let the Wildborn think us cowards? You're the general. You know your troops—
say:7:1510912002:0.source_cn: 现在撤退只会助长兽人的气焰，让他们笑话呼临人全都是懦夫！

say:8:1510912003:1.text: We'd sooner fall on this soil than be mocked as spineless deserters! We'll hold this damn fort with our bare hands if we have to. Halia will not fall!
say:8:1510912003:1.source_cn: 你是统帅，你应该最了解士兵们的想法！我们宁可死在战场上...

say:9:1510912004:0.text: ... Listen to me, Lygos. I know your courage. I trust your loyalty. But the Wildborn aren't just some warband; they fight under the Hunting Goddess' protection.
say:9:1510912004:0.source_cn: ……听着，隆尔。我相信你和士兵们的忠勇，也相信你们的能...

say:10:1510912005:0.text: Pitting steel against a god's favor is slaughter, not bravery! How many more must die before you see that?
say:10:1510912005:0.source_cn: 用凡人的力量对抗神力，纯粹是在白白送死！难道你要眼睁睁...

say:11:1510912006:0.text: If we pull back now, we live to regroup—to strike when the odds are ours again.
say:11:1510912006:0.source_cn: 现在，只有撤退才能保住我们的力量，等待反攻的时机。

say:12:1510912007:0.text: Stop fearmongering, Perseus! If we retreat now, all that awaits us is death!
say:12:1510912007:0.source_cn: 别危言耸听了，珀尔修斯！一旦撤退，等着我们的只有死亡！

say:13:1510912008:0.text: Where would we even retreat to? How long could we hide?! Only by fighting the Wildborn to the death do we have even a sliver of hope!
say:13:1510912008:0.source_cn: 退能退到什么地方？躲又能躲到何时！只有与兽人决一死战，...

say:14:1510912009:1.text: Lygos! That's not hope—that's sacrificing lives for nothing!
say:14:1510912009:1.source_cn: 隆尔！那不是生机，是让士兵们去送死！

say:15:1510912010:0.text: Defy me again, and I will bring down the full weight of martial law. I won't let your pride kill us all.
say:15:1510912010:0.source_cn: 若你再不听令……我只能按军规处置！

cinematic_dialogue:18:1510913001:.text: This isn't where you belong, Perseus!
cinematic_dialogue:18:1510913001:.source_cn: 那里不是你该在的地方，珀尔修斯！

narration:21:1501092112:0.text: Hearing Azora's call, Lygos becomes convinced that Perseus is a traitor and stabs him in the back. Infuriated, Azora shatters the wall of light and slays Lygos.
narration:21:1501092112:0.source_cn: 听闻狩猎神的呼唤，副官坚信统帅通敌，背刺珀尔修斯。爱人...

narration:22:1501092112:0.text: Hearing Azora's call, Lygos becomes convinced that Perseus is a traitor and stabs him in the back. Infuriated, Azora shatters the wall of light and slays Lygos.
narration:22:1501092112:0.source_cn: 听闻狩猎神的呼唤，副官坚信统帅通敌，背刺珀尔修斯。爱人...

say:6:1510940001:0.text: The beasts summoned by the goddess are attacking everyone, including the Wildborn...
say:6:1510940001:0.source_cn: 奥法迦召唤的野兽在攻击所有人，包括雅库伯尔人……

say:11:1510940003:0.text: ... They've been corrupted by the goddess <style="highlight">falling from grace</style>. Her fall... has already begun.

say:12:1510940004:0.text: We don't have time—save as many as you can!
say:12:1510940004:0.source_cn: 不要浪费时间，赶快救人！

narration:15:15010933:0.text: Azora departs with Perseus' body in her arms. Under the goddess' influence, the beasts start attacking both the Halians and Wildborn. Kordan is left devastated by Oboe's death.
narration:15:15010933:0.source_cn: 狩猎神护着珀尔修斯的尸体离开。堕神驱使的野兽不分敌我，...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510908002:.text: The flow of magic is intensifying...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510908003:.text: Come, let's head to the battlefield!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510908004:.text: What are you standing around for? Let's go!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510920004:.text: Leave this place! Stop meddling in my business!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510920004:.source_cn: 滚回你的领地！少插手我的事！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510920005:.text: You're the one who meddled in the affairs of mortals first!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510920005:.source_cn: 是你先插手了凡人的战争！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510920006:.source_cn: 离开这里，先去救你的士兵！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510920009:.text: Enough yelling. We're your opponents now.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510920009:.source_cn: 别喊了，我们才是你的对手

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510914108:.text: Stop! I haven't given the order to attack!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510914108:.source_cn: 住手——！我还没允许你们动手！

cinematic_summary:1.text: Perseus is killed by the Wildborn warriors. Consumed by grief, the Hunting Goddess falls.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 珀尔修斯被雅库伯尔战士围攻至死。目睹一切的狩猎神悲痛不已，彻底神堕。
